scope: Read-only aggregate revalidation of persisted quarantined Feishu receipt copies; no attachment content was parsed.

evidence.verification: Recomputed every stored-copy SHA-256 and matched it to the receipt SHA-256; all copies remained quarantined and unparsed.

redaction: No receipt path, message ID, account ID, chat ID, sender ID, filename, SHA-256 value, or media content is recorded.
limitations: This report proves safe ingress and stored-copy integrity only; it does not prove single-consumer message-id deduplication or outbound delivery.
The historical receipt schema stores one receipt SHA-256; stored-copy integrity was independently rechecked instead of inventing missing source/stored fields.
